Trainee Registration · v4.1

Complete multi-page POC update · 3 October 2026

Two registration routes

Trainer/Admin can upload the trainee Excel template from the Trainees page. Preview validates the complete list before an atomic save. Bulk upload remains available whether open registration is enabled or disabled, before final batch closure.

Enable open registration for a permitted batch, then open or copy its batch-specific registration link. The form accepts Mobile Number and email where applicable, requests a simulated OTP and verifies it before registration. A new trainee receives a Unique ID. The lookup form accepts mobile/email and requires its own simulated OTP challenge.

Business rules

  1. Open registration can be enabled or disabled per batch.
  2. Registration is restricted to the batch in the link; an invalid batch link cannot fall back to another batch.
  3. Capacity is checked for open registration and Excel upload, including revalidation before saving.
  4. Day 1 registration is the provisional default. An explicitly selected batch-period policy allows registration between the start and end dates.
  5. Trainer/Admin can close open registration.
  6. Trainer/Admin can upload trainees while open registration is enabled.
  7. The assigned trainer must approve the entire trainee list before final batch closure. Other completion criteria remain subject to business decisions.
  8. Duplicate normalized mobile numbers or email addresses are prevented within the same batch, including within an uploaded list.

Review boundaries

OTP 123456 is simulated and is bound to the requested contact, purpose and batch. Data and sample permissions are stored locally in the same browser. A shared URL does not transfer data to another browser. Real messaging, shared database, server authorization, transactional capacity/duplicate checks and durable audit require a backend. Cross-batch duplicate policy and alternate registration windows require business confirmation.

Review walkthrough

Serve the extracted folder using python -m http.server 8080 and open index.html. Select the assigned trainer persona, choose a batch under Trainees, enable registration, and open its registration page. For a successful demo set the batch start date to today or select the documented batch-period policy. Request OTP before using 123456. Try duplicate and over-capacity submissions, close registration, upload a valid Excel list, and approve the list before reviewing closure.
